title: HEAVY LEGS · REDLINE
vibe: GREEN · HEAVY SQUAT + POWER, THEN A FOR-TIME REDLINE (run kept optional & easy)
why: You slept 8 hours, nothing is sore, and you want more intensity, so today we go get it, just not with a fourth run. Your legs have been getting pounded by running (three 2-mile efforts this week) but they have not been strength-loaded since 07-10, over a week ago, and your upper body just got hammered yesterday. So the intensity goes into heavy double front squats paired with explosive swings for power, then a short for-time redline to spike the engine. That is harder than another tempo and it spares the impact your legs have been taking. Mobility opens it (hips and ankles today), a core and grip block closes it. The run is optional and easy Zone 2 only, no third tempo, skip it if you are tight on the 50 minutes. Read as GREEN off your check-in; if you somehow wake up flat, drop the squat to 4 sets and cut the redline to two rounds.

blocks.title: MOBILITY WARM-UP
blocks.meta: ~8 min · standing rule · hip + ankle biased for squatting
blocks.text: Pulse first: easy jog OR jumping jacks / arm swings 3 min. Original Strength resets: diaphragmatic breathing x5 · head nods + rotations 5 each · quadruped rock-backs x10 · cross-crawls 10/side. Then open the hips and ankles for squatting: deep-squat pry 60s · 90/90 hip switches 6/side · ankle rock-to-wall 8/side · world's-greatest-stretch 4/side · leg swings 10/side front and lateral · cat-cow x8. Finish with 2 sets of 5 empty-hand goblet squats to groove full depth. Legs do the work today, so get the hips and ankles fully open before you load the front rack.

blocks.title: HEAVY SQUAT + POWER
blocks.meta: ~16 min · 2x40 lb (80 lb) · contrast pair, push the load
blocks.workRest: 5 rounds · A1 heavy then A2 explosive · rest 90-120s between rounds

items.name: A1 · Double Front Squat
items.detail: 2x40 (80 lb) · 5 x 5 · elbows high, brace hard, own full depth, grind the last rep clean

items.name: A2 · Explosive Double Swing
items.detail: 2x40 (80 lb) · 5 x 8 · snap the hips, float the bells, all power not grind

blocks.text: Contrast training straight from the athletic-power world: a heavy strength lift followed by an explosive one primes the nervous system, so the squats feel strong and the swings feel snappy. Front squat has been sitting since 07-10, so go get it, 5 sets of 5, heavy but clean. If the front rack fatigues before the legs do, switch to a 50 lb goblet squat and keep the load on. The double swings are pure power, drive with the hips, do not muscle them up with the arms. This is where most of your intensity lives today.

blocks.title: REDLINE CHIPPER
blocks.format: 15-12-9 · FOR TIME · one clock, straight through
blocks.workRest: move continuously, rest only as needed, log your finish time

items.name: 15-12-9 · KB Swing
items.detail: 16 kg · hinge hard and fast, chest-height float

items.name: 15-12-9 · Goblet Squat
items.detail: 16 kg · full depth, elbows inside the knees

items.name: 15-12-9 · Burpee
items.detail: bodyweight · chest to floor, jump at the top (step back if the knees complain)

blocks.text: One descending ladder for time: 15 of each, then 12, then 9, straight through with the stopwatch running. This is your redline and your conditioning in one, no treadmill needed. Swings and goblet squats keep the legs moving under light load, the burpees spike the heart rate and are today's wildcard. Push the pace but keep the swings crisp. Target under 8 minutes. If you gas out, keep moving and just slow down, do not stop the clock. This is the extra intensity you asked for.

blocks.title: EASY ZONE 2 — OPTIONAL
blocks.meta: ~8-10 min · treadmill · easy only, or skip
blocks.workRest: one easy continuous effort, or skip it to protect the 50 min
blocks.text: You have done three 2-mile efforts this week and your legs just took heavy squats plus a redline, so if you run at all today it is EASY Zone 2, conversational, 6.0 to 6.3 mph, not a step faster. Honestly, with 50 minutes and everything above, skipping this is the right call most days, or swap it for a 5-minute incline walk at 3 mph and 10 percent to flush the legs. Do not turn this into a fourth tempo.

blocks.title: CORE + GRIP FINISHER
blocks.meta: ~7 min · anti-rotation + the grip work you wanted · standing rule

items.name: Suitcase Carry
items.detail: 50 lb DB · 40 steps/side · stand tall, crush the handle, no side-lean

items.name: Hollow Hold
items.detail: 30s · ribs down, low back pressed flat to the floor

items.name: Side Plank
items.detail: 30s/side · stack the hips, reach the top arm tall

blocks.text: Your end-of-session midline block with grip baked in since you like it. The suitcase carry is anti-lateral-flexion and hammers grip and forearms, the hollow is anti-extension, the side plank is anti-rotation. Brace hard, move slow, three clean rounds. This is the core that keeps your back happy under all the squatting.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Walk 2 min @ 3 mph. Then decompress the legs and hips: couch stretch 45s/side · figure-4 or pigeon 45s/side · standing forward fold 45s · seated straddle 45s · child's pose 45s · 5 slow breaths. Spend the most time on whatever is tightest from the squats.

timer.emomUnit: for-time redline · run the stopwatch on the 15-12-9
